job.title: Research Analyst/Portfolio Administrator
job.description:
Research Analyst – Portfolio Administrator

Boutique high-end fund seeks Research Analyst – Portfolio Administrator to work as part of small team responsible for Global Equities Research and Portfolio Administration. The role is a hybrid position that combines fundamental company research with portfolio administration and reporting.

This is a direct hire full time position with a firm that offers a very professional work environment, great work life balance, and competitive compensation.

This would be a great match for an early-career professional with a strong finance/accounting background (portfolio accounting, fund accounting,…) who wants to work for a boutique investment fund focused on equities/global equities. This is a very supportive, collaborative work environment with opportunities for growth.

In summary, you will support the firm’s investment and operations efforts, with a focus on the international equity strategies. as part of a small, tight knit team.

The ideal candidate enjoys a dynamic, in-office environment and the camaraderie of working with a small team.

In summary, you will:

A. Research
• Conduct fundamental company analysis
• Monitor and communicate company and market news
• Participate in company management conference calls; attend company meetings and industry conferences
• Support Portfolio Manager’s company research, trading, and client servicing activities

B. Portfolio Administration and Support
• Serve as backup for portfolio accounting and reconciliation
• Monitor client portfolios
• Assist in the preparation of client reporting

Requirements include:
• Completed college degree, Economics, Finance, Math or other related quantitative course of study preferred
• 0 to 2 years of relevant experience; recent graduates are eligible to apply
• Strong quantitative skills and proficiency with Excel; comfortable working with financial information and AI tools
• Demonstrably interested in global markets
• Extremely organized and meticulous, with an accountant’s mindset
• A team player with a can-do attitude
• Personality traits: intellectually curious; honest, ethical, and trustworthy; self-motivated, patient, and persistent; adaptable and willing to take on a variety of responsibilities
• Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills
• This is a 5 day per week onsite role based in the Stamford Connecticut area

job.title: Compliance Analyst
job.description:
High End mid-sized Fund seeks Compliance Analyst with 3-36 months of Compliance experience.

Designed for an early-career compliance professional looking to build a long-term foundation in asset management, this role offers direct mentorship alongside our senior compliance team in Greenwich. You will quickly transition from core daily workflows into broader trade surveillance, regulatory reporting, and investment guideline monitoring across global strategies.


These responsibilities focus on portfolio and trade surveillance to ensure that the firm maintains compliance with client guidelines and regulatory requirements, conducting transactional, forensic testing and compliance reviews.

This role offers the opportunity to develop broad, hands-on experience across investment compliance, trading, regulatory reporting, and firmwide compliance within a global asset management firm. As a member of the Compliance team, you will work closely with portfolio managers, traders, operations, and senior compliance professionals while taking on meaningful responsibilities.


This is a great career opportunity with a firm that offers extensive professional training and the opportunity for advancement with first year total compensation of $90,000-$130,000 and great benefits package.

This role is hybrid and requires working onsite 3 days per week.


In summary, you will assist in supporting senior Compliance members in the following areas:

  • Pre and post trade investment compliance monitoring
  • Compliance program monitoring and testing
  • Code of ethics monitoring
  • Preparation of regulatory filings (13F, ADV, Form PF)
  • Trade surveillance
  • Adhoc projects


Specifically, you will:

  • Support pre- and post-trade investment compliance monitoring for client accounts and mutual fund portfolios using EZE Compliance, including client guidelines, mutual fund trade restrictions, and UCITS requirements.
  • Work directly with portfolio managers and traders in an active trading environment to identify and help resolve investment compliance matters.
  • Support the firm’s compliance program, including employee onboarding, personal trading monitoring, brokerage feeds, annual attestations, and Code of Ethics requirements.
  • Conduct compliance testing and reviews across areas including best execution, proxy voting, cash and position reconciliations, trade confirmations, window dressing, and AML reviews.
  • Assist with regulatory filings and reporting, including Forms 13F, 13H, ADV, and PF, as well as the firm’s annual SOC controls audits.
  • Support quarterly billing processes for separately managed accounts and contribute to compliance-related responses for client and prospect DDQs.
  • Partner with senior members of the Compliance team on projects and firmwide initiatives, contributing ideas to help enhance processes and controls.


Requirements include:

  • A completed Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related discipline, paired with foundational exposure to buy-side compliance (some related full-time experience or a specialized internship, or compliance consulting).
  • 3-36 months of Compliance experience, preferably in Investment Management or with a Consulting Firm that services Investment Managers.
  • Familiarity with the following programs strongly preferred: EZE Compliance, ComplySci, Bloomberg, Refinitive World Check
  • Compliance experience related to Equities and/or Global Equities preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within investment, trading, operations, and other teams across the firm.
  • Excellent attention to detail while working through tight timelines and strict deadlines
  • Proactive, organized, and accountable, with sound judgment and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • Ability to prioritize, organize and manage multiple tasks in a professional, fast-paced environment
  • The ideal candidate is hard-working, driven, smart, accountable, efficient, humble, and collaborative.
  • Problem solver and strategic thinker; strong problem recognition and resolution skills
  • Experience with 1940 Act fund compliance is a plus.
  • Strong work ethic and professional demeanor
  • Strong analytical skills

job.title: Sr Developer Angular/Python

  • Design database schemas and write tuned SQL across RDBMS platforms (Amazon RDS/Aurora, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server)
  • Build and operate AWS infrastructure: EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudWatch
  • Design for high availability and reliability in 24/7 environments - redundancy, health checks, monitoring, alerting, backup and recovery
  • Own incident response end-to-end: triage, recovery, root cause analysis, and permanent fixes
  • Execute regular maintenance: patching, releases, performance testing
  • Lead incident response efforts including initial investigation, recovery, root cause analysis, and implementation of permanent fixes.
  • Translate business requirements into technical designs and actionable implementation plans.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, operations, and business teams - and be able to explain a technical decisions in plain English to a non-technical stakeholder


What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining web applications and backend systems
  • Strong Angular and Python skills - you write code you're proud of, not just code that works
  • Solid AWS experience across core services (EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudWatch)
  • Proven comfort with RDBMS: schema design, SQL tuning, and performance optimization
  • Familiarity with Linux environments and scripting/automation tools
  • Experience with system monitoring, incident response, and high-availability design
  • Strong written and verbal communication; you think clearly and express ideas precisely
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record
  • Experience in financial services - banking, asset management, custody, prime brokerage, or a fintech serving those industries - is a significant advantage
  • Familiarity with back-office operations (settlements, reconciliation, corporate actions, custody, payments, or compliance workflows) is especially valued


Why join us

  • At a smaller firm, your work is visible, your judgment is trusted, and your growth isn't gated by headcount cycles
  • Build real, production systems that directly support investment operations — not internal tooling, not support tickets
  • Build more in two years here than you would in five at a large institution
  • Midtown Manhattan office - accessible from across the metro area, with hybrid flexibility
  • A tight-knit, experienced team that will challenge you and invest in you

job.title: Administrative Assistant
job.description:
Administrative Assistant

Make a meaningful impact behind the scenes by keeping daily operations organized, responsive, and running smoothly across the Management Office and Administration/Human Resources Department. This role offers the opportunity to work independently, collaborate across teams, and support a wide range of essential business functions.

Overview

Reporting to the Department Head, you will provide comprehensive administrative support across the New York and New Jersey sites. You’ll coordinate office needs, maintain accurate records, support consultants and vendors, and help ensure a safe, orderly workplace.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide administrative support, including telephone coverage, mail and supplies, travel arrangements, expense tracking, filing, deliveries, visitor access, event coordination, and routine requests.
  • Support consultant onboarding, job descriptions, timesheets, invoices, terminations, and related records.
  • Maintain records and fixed-asset documentation, and support equipment purchasing, moves, and disposal.
  • Manage pantry and stationery inventory, purchasing, and monthly records.
  • Process invoices and centralized procurement in line with policy.
  • Maintain check records and blank check stock inventory.
  • Liaise with building management and vendors on facilities, visitor, maintenance, and service matters.
  • Update phone extension lists and organizational charts.
  • Assist with Head Office staff needs and provide backup coverage for department staff.
  • Perform other assignments as directed by the Department Head or alternate.

Must-Have

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • At least one year of relevant work experience.
  • Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Fluency in spoken and written Mandarin Chinese and English.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.
  • Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment and work independently or collaboratively.

Bring your administrative expertise and collaborative approach to this important support role—apply today.

job.title: Operations Associate
job.description:
Operations Associate- Boutique Fund is hiring an Operations Associate in Stamford, CT.


You will support investment operations, reporting and data management across diverse equities transactions. In this hybrid role onsite 4 days per week, you will play an important role in investment operations and reporting, serving as a key resource for the trading desk.

This is a full-time direct hire role at the 100-110K+ bonus level, and a great opportunity to join a high-end firm that will give you opportunity to grow your career.


Responsibilities include:

  • Perform daily investment operations, including responding to trade and position breaks, processing cash flows, reviewing new security master data, managing corporate actions and mutual fund tax-harvesting activity, and monitoring data flows.
  • Manage recurring deliverables including internal and external reporting and the generation and distribution of client statements
  • Handle ad hoc operational work including opening, closing, and transitioning accounts; onboarding custodians and brokers; processing audit confirmations; and providing data for client and prospect DDQs and RFPs
  • Serve as the primary liaison with an outsourced middle-office provider and fund administrators
  • Support the trading desk, as needed, with program trading and unified managed account (UMA) portfolio trading.
  • Analyze and report on data in Microsoft Excel using advanced formulas and pivot tables
  • Act as a data steward for assigned data domains, including investment book of record information
  • Contribute to strategic firm initiatives and cross-functional projects

Qualifications include:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related course of study
  • Industry Experience: 3+ years of investment management industry experience, preferably with an equity asset manager or fund administrator
  • Equities Operations: Working knowledge of equity securities and equity mutual funds or hedge funds including a strong understanding of equities operations including trade settlements, reconciliations, performance or fee calculations, corporate actions, or portfolio/fund accounting. Exposure to derivatives, including swaps and options, is a plus.
  • Technical Skills: Advanced Excel proficiency required including pivot tables and functions such as XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMPRODUCT, and IF statements
  • Good understanding of OMS trade flow and accounting / portfolio management systems
  • Skills & Attributes: Analytical and systems-savvy professional with strong attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, ownership mindset, and the ability to manage complex datasets in a fast-paced investment environment

job.title: Cloud Infrastructure & Engineering Leader
job.description:
Cloud Infrastructure & Engineering Leader

Are you a seasoned IT Infrastructure leader with deep hands-on expertise in data center and enterprise infrastructure management within the financial sector? We are seeking a strategic and driven IT Infrastructure Architect to oversee, optimize, and innovate our local NY data center and co-location infrastructure.

Join a mid-sized asset management firm offering a stable working environment, a very good benefits package, and the opportunity to make a tangible impact through the systems and solutions you design. Our relationship with this client spans more than two decades, giving us an in-depth understanding of the business.

This is a hands-on leadership role: you will architect cloud and infrastructure solutions, lead and mentor a small team of systems engineers, and work directly through technical design and operational challenges. You will help move the firm toward cloud-first infrastructure while keeping critical services reliable in a regulated, 24x7 environment. Alongside AWS architecture and delivery partner oversight, your remit covers virtual desktop services and the foundations for data and AI initiatives.

This is a full-time direct hire role working hybrid onsite 2 - 3 days per week in Midtown Manhattan with an organization that offers competitive compensation and a great benefits package.

This critical role offers the opportunity to ensure the stability, security, and compliance of our core banking operations. If you are a proven leader with a stable career history and a passion for driving IT excellence, we want to hear from you.

Shape the Cloud Environment

  • Translate infrastructure priorities into an actionable cloud roadmap, supported by clear design principles and an operating model.
  • Take architectural responsibility for AWS foundations: Landing Zones, account structures, VPC networking and connectivity, identity and access, security, observability, and recovery capabilities.
  • Direct migration and re-platforming programs, using architecture reviews, proofs of concept, and engineering standards to guide delivery.


Keep Critical Services Reliable

  • Oversee round-the-clock infrastructure services and provide senior technical direction when major incidents require escalation.
  • Set expectations for automated provisioning, configuration control, security, monitoring, incident response, change control, and operational documentation.
  • Manage cloud expenditure through forecasting, optimization, resource tagging, and cost allocation, including showback and chargeback.


Lead Engineers and Delivery Partners

  • Lead and mentor a small team of systems engineers, working alongside them on architecture, solution design, and technical problem-solving, with clear ownership of engineering outcomes.
  • Oversee providers and delivery partners, including managed service providers, systems integrators, and consultants, across cloud and end-user services.
  • Manage commercial and service performance through contracts, statements of work, service-level commitments, KPIs, reviews, budgets, risk controls, and escalations.
  • Ensure external delivery meets internal architecture, security, regulatory, documentation, and operational requirements.


Enable Desktop, Data, and AI Services

  • Oversee the architecture and operation of Azure Virtual Desktop and associated virtual desktop services.
  • Guide desktop design across identity integration with Entra ID and Active Directory, networking, security, FSLogix profiles, image management, application delivery, capacity, availability, and recovery.
  • Work with application, data, security, and architecture colleagues on infrastructure for AI-assisted development, enterprise data lakes, analytics, machine learning, and generative AI.
  • Assess cloud services and engineering approaches for these initiatives, balancing scalability and innovation with security and governance.


Requirements include

  • A bachelor's degree and 8-10 years in enterprise infrastructure, cloud engineering, or architecture, with substantial leadership responsibility.
  • Practical experience acting as the technical authority for large-scale AWS architecture, covering Landing Zones, multi-account environments, networking, IAM, security, monitoring, resilience, backup, and disaster recovery.
  • Experience building infrastructure through code with Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.
  • A track record of delivering cloud migrations, modernization, or wider infrastructure change.
  • Experience leading and mentoring a small engineering team while remaining hands-on in systems architecture, solution design, and technical escalations.
  • Evidence of managing technology vendors and service partners, including delivery governance, SLAs and KPIs, service reviews, contracts or statements of work, escalations, and financial oversight.
  • Experience keeping business-critical production systems running in a 24x7 environment.
  • A background in financial services or another highly regulated sector.
  • The ability to communicate with executives, work effectively with stakeholders, exercise sound technical judgment, and produce clear documentation.

job.title: Network Security Engineer
job.description:
Network Security Engineer
Work Eligible: US Citizen/Green card,... No H1-B, No F-1 OPT,...
Must be local to NYC area


High Profile mid-sized Asset Management Firm seeks Network Security Engineer with strong Threat Vulnerability Management experience.

In a very hands-on capacity you will responsible for the support and administration of several core network security tools... interesting projects, very professional and high-end environment.

You will be responsible for the administration, engineering, and support of security initiatives related to Threat Vulnerability Management and Network Security.

This is a full-time direct hire role with a targeted base salary of 130,000 - 140,000 plus an annual bonus and a great benefits package (8% company retirement contribution, 4 weeks vacation,...).

In summary:

  • Work closely with Information Security to ensure a secure enterprise network environment through the enforcement of network security controls, threat and vulnerability management (TVM), and logging and monitoring for applications, servers and network devices through the SIEM process.
  • Leverage and implement tools that automate and support Network Security, TVM and SIEM processes, helping to develop capabilities to early detect and quickly respond to potential cybersecurity breaches and incidents.
  • Implement appropriate changes, updates, and upgrades in response to vulnerabilities and incursions; help to gather evidence for audits and to remediate audit issues.
  • Support the process owners for Network Security, Threat Vulnerability Management and and SIEM by actively participating in risk assessments
  • Participate in the organization and coordination of penetration testing.
  • Review and respond to alerts generated by the Cyber Security Operations Center teams.
  • Review, respond and resolve alerts originating Carbon Black products to ensure appropriate system processing and applications requirements are met.
  • Ensure Microsoft Defender / McAfee alerts are monitored and resolved.
  • Assist and deploy standard firewall rules.
  • Implement appropriate changes, updates, and upgrades in response to vulnerabilities and incursions.
  • Provide day-to-day support of network security systems in a backup capacity.
  • Follow run books for deployments and/or system upgrades during and off-hours.
  • Participate in metric collection to demonstrate situational awareness to management regarding current threats and risks.


Requirements include:

  • Experience with Vulnerability Management solutions and relevant work experience with tools that provide vulnerability detection and reporting, logging and monitoring, and other cybersecurity solutions such as IPS/IDS, anti-virus and DLP.
  • Working knowledge of next-gen firewall administration and configuration; some related Palo Alto Firewall administration (Panorama), network security, operations and management best practices preferred
  • Endpoint management and best practices: McAfee Endpoint Protection, Microsoft Defender, Carbon Black, and LogRhythm.
  • Understanding of network design, infrastructure, Active Directory and Group Policy
  • Knowledge of enterprise patching / updates is a must
  • Scripting skills (Python,,...)
  • Working knowledge of security protocols, authentication, authorization and security.
  • Strong hands-on experience with public cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) in production environments.
  • Preferred certifications or professional training: ITIL Foundation and any training with Palo Alto, Carbon Black, Tenable/Nessus and/or LogRhythm
  • Ability to resolve security alerts in a timely manner and escalate events that could lead to a security breach.
  • Analytical skills to troubleshoot events and correlate user or system activity.
  • Hands-on experience deploying firewall rules to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Good Project Management skills
  • Completed Bachelor’s degree with Computer Science or related (math, engineering,...) course of study.


*This is a hybrid role onsite ~3 days per week in NYC

job.title: Syndicated Loan Ops Analyst
job.description:
Syndicated Loan Operations – NYC Hybrid

You know the drill with loan operations: notices from agent banks hit your inbox, bookings come through from the front office, payments need to get out the door, reconciliations have to tie out, and reports land on your desk by day’s end.

If you enjoy that rhythm, but want to do it in a tight-knit NYC team where your work is visible, valued, and tied directly to global transactions, this could be the right next step; competitive compensation the salary range for the role is $75,000-95,000 per year; and hybrid onsite 2-3+ days per week.

What you’ll be doing here

  • Running the daily flow for syndicated and bilateral fund finance loans (plus some time deposits).
  • Making sure bookings from the Fund Finance Group are clean in the Loan GL system, and payments are processed accurately.
  • Keeping an eye on notices from agent banks and jumping in when communications need to be clarified.
  • Owning daily USD and currency positions for the group — downloading, checking, and circulating BOD/EOD reports.
  • Pulling together month-end and term-end reporting and making sure the numbers add up.
  • Investigating when reconciliations don’t balance and fixing issues before they snowball.
  • Cross-training on collateral management so you’ve got breadth beyond loan ops.
  • Pitching in on audits, system upgrades, UAT, and the inevitable “special projects.”

What makes this role different

  • Visibility: You’re not buried in a massive back-office hub — you’re at the NYC branch, working closely with the front office and Fund Finance team.
  • Variety: This isn’t a narrow ticket-punching role. You’ll see loans front-to-back, handle multiple products, and touch reporting, reconciliations, and controls.
  • Growth: The team values cross-training (collateral management, regulatory processes, new systems). You’ll keep adding tools to your skillset.
  • Balance: Hybrid schedule (2–3 days in Midtown), reasonable hours, and stability in a global institution.

What we’re looking for

  • Someone with 2+ years in loan operations experience with syndicated/bilateral loans.
  • Comfortable with the details (loan docs, notices, reconciliations) but also curious to learn the bigger picture.
  • Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills. SWIFT knowledge is a plus.
  • A communicator who can keep agent banks, the Fund Finance Group, and internal stakeholders on the same page.
  • Based in the NYC area and ready to come in a few days a week.

job.title: Bank Internal Auditor
job.description:
Mid-sized Asset Management Firm seeks Internal Auditor (Assistant Vice President).

You will be the auditor in charge performing audits including preparation of detailed work papers supporting the audit results and audit report inclusive of management action plans.

job.title: Derivatives Operations Specialist
job.description:
Derivatives Operations Specialist – Hybrid (NYC)

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, proactive operations professional to join our team in New York City.

This role offers the chance to work on complex securities and derivatives operations while being part of a collaborative environment that values hands-on experience and practical problem solving; competitive compensation- the salary range for the role is $75,000-$95,000 per year, the position is hybrid, with 2–3 days onsite in Manhattan each week.

What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be at the center of our securities and derivatives operations, ensuring transactions settle accurately and efficiently. Day-to-day, you will:

  • Process securities trades, manage settlements, handle corporate actions, and oversee related operations like fee processing and repo margin calls.
  • Support derivatives operations, including cleared swaps, credit default indices (CDX), cross-currency swaps, futures/options, and LCH margin call operations.
  • Investigate and resolve trade discrepancies, settlement issues, and confirmations with custodians and brokers.
  • Prepare and validate daily and term-end reports for internal management and other teams.
  • Manage settlement instructions and updates independently using SWIFT, Money Transfer, and other custodian systems.
  • Collaborate on process improvements, new product testing, and documentation updates for policies and procedures.
  • Support audits, regulatory inquiries, and compliance initiatives.
  • Participate in cross-training and special projects, continuously learning to stay current with market practices and operational best practices.

Who You Are

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of hands-on experience in securities and/or derivatives operations.
  • You understand settlement practices (Fedwire, DTC, Euroclear) and corporate actions, and are familiar with TMPG/CSDR guidelines.
  • You have hands-on experience with SWIFT messages (MT54x, MT2xx) and derivative operations (cleared swaps, CDS, CDX). Knowledge of ISDA Master agreements or Dodd-Frank regulations is a plus.
  • You are comfortable using Microsoft Office, Outlook, and custodian systems (such as Easyway, JPM Market, CitiVelocity, Markitwire).
  • You thrive in a team environment but can also work independently, solving problems efficiently and adapting to changing situations.
  • You value accuracy, communication, and taking ownership of your work.

Why This Role

  • This is an opportunity to apply your operational expertise in a hybrid setup that blends onsite collaboration with flexible workdays. You’ll have a tangible impact on critical transactions while being part of a knowledgeable, supportive team in Manhattan.
